## Outcome

Describe the player-visible or production-pipeline result.

## Acceptance evidence

- [ ] `pnpm test:all` passes.
- [ ] Stable content IDs and legacy-save behavior are preserved or explicitly migrated.
- [ ] New assets have source, license, hash, budget, and maturity metadata.
- [ ] Bestiary changes retain unique anatomy, locomotion, sound, mechanic, and habitat signatures.
- [ ] GIS changes pass deterministic hashes, terrain-conditioning, drainage, topology, route, and habitat gates.
- [ ] Showcase mechanics remain server-authoritative and navigation resolves through canonical cells.

## Maturity claims

- [ ] Authored/validated/habitat-valid/integrated/prototype/production/playtested states are reported independently.
- [ ] The change does not imply production models, seamless Reach traversal, performance approval, or playtesting without evidence.

## Risk and rollback

List persistence, protocol, content-ID, GIS, performance, or security risks and the rollback path.
